messages:
amanda_cust: Hey team — after upgrading to redwood-python-sdk==2.0.0 our production service started getting 400s and we saw a billing spike. Repro locally with simple call below, error is `TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout'`. Any ideas?

amanda_cust: repro steps:
```bash
pip install redwood-python-sdk==2.0.0
python -c \"from redwood import RedwoodClient; c=RedwoodClient(api_key=\'sk-xxx\'); c.generate(\"hello\", timeout=30)\"\n```

kevin_support: Sorry you're hitting this, Amanda. Can you paste the full stack trace and one `request_id` from the 400 response? Also did you change any retry or idempotency code?

amanda_cust: stack trace: 
```
TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout'
  File \"/app/server.py\", line 42, in <module>
    res = client.generate(prompt, timeout=30)
```
request_id: rq_01F2XQ0K
we didn't change idempotency keys; we rely on SDK retries being safe (previously hermetic).

mike_sdk: tagging in — thanks for clear repro. Quick summary: 2.0.0 introduced a breaking signature change that moved several per-call params (timeout, stream, max_response_tokens) into a named config object `RequestConfig`, and we also changed the retry default from 2->4 and moved retry logic one layer earlier. That combo surfaced as TypeError for positional usage and can trigger duplicate backend attempts if customers weren't passing an explicit `idempotency_key`.

amanda_cust: oh — that explains the TypeError. But why did we see a billing spike (duplicate token usage)? We didn't set idempotency keys before. Previously we relied on SDK-level dedupe?

kevin_support: Historically the SDK implicitly set an idempotency key per call to avoid duplicates on retries. 2.0.0 made that opt-in for some calls to support streaming/partial-resume use cases. We should have documented it more prominently — sorry for the break.

elaine_billing: FYI billing team — we got a few incoming tickets referencing token usage spike from one customer using 2.0.0. We'll reverse-charge if we confirm duplicate attempts. Amanda, can you confirm the timestamps of the burst and approximate token delta?

amanda_cust: burst around 2026-03-12T14:03:00Z total tokens ~ +23k vs normal. Happy to get a credit if duplicate requests are confirmed.

mike_sdk: actionable plan: (1) immediate workaround — pin to 1.7.8 which keeps the old signature and implicit idempotency; (2) short-term patch 2.0.1 to restore a backward-compatible alias for the common per-call params and preserve implicit idempotency for non-streaming generate calls; (3) medium-term: add explicit opt-out and clear changelog/upgrade guide.

amanda_cust: ok can you confirm exact pip pin to fix this quickly?

mike_sdk: pin to `redwood-python-sdk==1.7.8` will restore previous behavior. Example rollback:
```bash
pip install redwood-python-sdk==1.7.8
# validate:
python -c \"from redwood import RedwoodClient; c=RedwoodClient(); c.generate(\"hello\", timeout=30)\"\n```

sre_oncall: also as mitigation on our side we can enable server-side dedupe for generate endpoints for a short grace window (10m) using fingerprinting of prompt+user-id, which will reduce damage even without idempotency_key. Will coordinate with infra.

kevin_support: Amanda — we're going to (A) issue a one-off credit for duplicate tokens while we investigate, (B) escalate to SDK team for a 2.0.1 patch, and (C) provide a concise upgrade note showing exact code changes and how to opt into the new RequestConfig pattern.

amanda_cust: thanks. How long for 2.0.1?

mike_sdk: target: hotfix release in ~4 hours to staging, 12 hours to prod if tests pass. The main changes are an alias layer and re-enabling implicit idempotency for non-streaming calls. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2345 (staging link below after deploy).

deploy-bot: deploy-started: staging-redwood-sdk-2.0.1-hotfix by mike_sdk at 1804124300

kevin_support: I've created a billing ticket for a preliminary credit and linked your request: BILL-7891. Elaine will follow up.

elaine_billing: billing ticket created and initial refund queued pending engineering verification of duplicate attempts and request logs.

mike_sdk: PATCH deployed to staging (2.0.1-rc). Can you validate the original repro against the RC? `pip install redwood-python-sdk==2.0.1rc0` then run the same snippet — should accept `timeout=` and preserve safe retries.

amanda_cust: validated `2.0.1rc0` on a clone of prod — `c.generate(\"hi\", timeout=30)` works and I don't see duplicated attempts in logs. Thank you.

kevin_support: marking this thread as resolved pending final prod rollout. We'll CC you once 2.0.1 is fully rolled out and refund confirmed. Apologies again for the disruption. :pray:

amanda_cust: appreciated — thanks for the quick response and the credit.

mike_sdk: followups: we'll push a clear upgrade guide and a changelog banner; adding an opt-in `implicit_idempotency=False` flag to RequestConfig for people who want the new behavior explicitly. PR and changelog links will be posted to the support thread when prod deploy completes.

deploy-bot: deploy-complete: prod-redwood-sdk-2.0.1 by mike_sdk at 1804125000

kevin_support: prod is live. Elaine, please finalize refund for Amanda.

elaine_billing: refund processed, reference BILL-7891-REFUND, should show in 3-5 biz days.

amanda_cust: got the email confirmation, thanks everyone. Closing on our side.
